research.notes: Agenda names both 'Asian Health Services' and 'Banteay Srei Asian Health Services'; Banteay Srei is a program/collaboration of AHS, so the profile describes AHS. No general email found on the homepage. Third-party listings give a different street address (818 Webster St); the address shown is from the organization's own website.

profile.summary: A nonprofit community health center in Oakland, California. It provides medical, dental and behavioral health care to more than 50,000 patients. It also runs community programs, including youth programs such as Banteay Srei, which supports young Southeast Asian women.

sources.title: Asian Health Services - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: Asian Health Services is an Oakland 501(c)(3) (EIN 94-2235908, confirmed on ProPublica) that lists Banteay Srei as a community program, and Banteay Srei's site says AHS, EBAYC and OUSD founded it, matching the agenda's names and student health services. Name, phone, address, patient count and summary are supported by the cited pages and the summary is neutral.
